heroHeadline: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey Issue Joint Demand Against Houthi Strikes
heroSubtitle: A four-country joint statement marks the broadest diplomatic front assembled under the Mecca Pact framework, as NYT analysis warns Saudi Arabia faces limited credible response options against escalating Houthi strikes on Riyadh and civilian targets.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
